passages.text:
USAID x Facebook
[contact omitted] Clare Amador
Tuesday, July 13, 2021 at 2:03:11 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Mercy Ria Orca,
[contact omitted] Gerry Fernando Patia,
[contact omitted] Ria Esguerra
Cc: [contact omitted] Maria Teresa (Philippines/OEDG) ([contact omitted]) Robielos, [contact omitted] Porta,
Gerardo (Philippines/OEDG), [contact omitted] Jose Maria Mendoza
Hi everyone,
Thank you for the call last week. As stated, here's the list of areas where Facebook can help and collaborate with your
programs/projects.
[contact omitted] I will respond separately to your email and Greg's. I am just waiting for feedback from my colleague who is speaking to ASC
and IMMAP.
[contact omitted] and all, as promised, here's the list:
Media / Ads
• Internews (3PFC incubation, reporting channel for Brgy Hub)
• Conversation with the Ads Industry for elections
• Industry Code of Conduct
• Ads policies for elections advertising
BARMM
• Facebook can offer the following training:
• Digital Literacy
• Digital Marketing (for entrepreneurs)
• Maximising Facebook (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Political Advertising Tools (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Facebook Community Standards (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Conversation around elections policies in BARMM
Democracy
• Digital Literacy training for young people, general public
Youth Advocacy playbook on Digital Empowerment
• Boses/Participate Survey
- Impact of disinformation to elections decisions and behaviour
• Possible training for COMELEC field offices on resiliency (mental health) and digital literacy)
• Conversation with COMELEC and the Ads Industry for elections
• Industry Code of Conduct
• Ads policies for elections advertising
Thank you and looking forward to what's next,
Clare
Clare Amador

Head of Public Policy
Philippines

From: Mercy Ria Orca <[contact omitted]>
Date: Thursday, 8 July 2021 at 11:03 AM
To: Clare Amador <[contact omitted]>
Cc: "Maria Teresa (Philippines/OEDG) ([contact omitted]) Robielos" <[contact omitted]>,
"Porta, Gerardo (Philippines/OEDG)" <[contact omitted]>, Jose Maria Mendoza
<[contact omitted]>
Subject: Email addresses
Hi Clare,
Thanks again for reaching out to exchange notes on the 2022 elections + collaboration
opportunities. Copied here colleagues who were in the meeting so we can be all connected via
email.
Democracy & Governance Team, Office of Economic Development and Governance,
USAID/Philippines:
• Ma. Teresa "Tet" Robielos - BARMM support project with The Asia Foundation
• Gerardo "Gerry" Porta - media freedom, disinformation project with Internews
• Joey Mendoza - youth & democracy project with The Asia Foundation and elections support
project with the Ateneo School of Govt
• Ria - human rights social behavior change with The Asia Foundation
Looking forward to future collaboration meetings.
Best,
Ria
